stories.title: Iraqi military commander dismissed after drone attacks against Saudi Arabia, prime minister’s office says

en.title: Iraqi military commander dismissed after drone attacks against Saudi Arabia, prime minister's office says
en.summary: An Iraqi military commander was removed from his position following an investigation that connected drone attacks on Saudi Arabia to Iraq, according to the Iraqi prime minister's office.

stories.title: السعودية ترحب بإطلاق التحالف العالمي للتعاون بين بلدان الجنوب والتعاون الثلاثي

en.title: Saudi Arabia welcomes launch of Global Alliance for cooperation between southern countries and trilateral cooperation
en.summary: Saudi Arabia expressed support for a new global alliance focused on cooperation among southern nations, noting its role in promoting integration and reducing duplicated efforts while respecting each country's national priorities.

stories.title: السعودية ترحب بإطلاق «تحالف التعاون بين بلدان الجنوب»

en.title: Saudi Arabia Welcomes Launch of 'South-South Cooperation Alliance'
en.summary: Saudi Arabia expressed support for the launch of a global alliance for cooperation between southern countries and trilateral cooperation, emphasizing its role in promoting integration and reducing duplicated efforts while respecting each nation's priorities.

es.title: Arabia Saudita Recibe Favorablemente el Lanzamiento de la «Alianza de Cooperación entre Países del Sur»
es.summary: Arabia Saudita manifestó su respaldo al lanzamiento de una alianza global de cooperación entre países del sur y cooperación trilateral, destacando su importancia en promover la integración y reducir esfuerzos duplicados respetando las prioridades de cada estado.

fr.title: L'Arabie Saoudite Accueille le Lancement de l'« Alliance de Coopération entre les Pays du Sud »
fr.summary: L'Arabie Saoudite a exprimé son soutien au lancement d'une alliance mondiale pour la coopération entre les pays du sud et la coopération trilatérale, soulignant son importance dans la promotion de l'intégration et la réduction des efforts redondants.

pt.title: Arábia Saudita Recebe Favoravelmente o Lançamento da «Aliança de Cooperação entre Países do Sul»
pt.summary: A Arábia Saudita expressou apoio ao lançamento de uma aliança global para cooperação entre países do sul e cooperação trilateral, destacando sua importância na promoção da integração e redução de esforços duplicados.

de.title: Saudi-Arabien Begrüßt Lancierung der «Süd-Süd-Kooperationsallianz»
de.summary: Saudi-Arabien sprach seine Unterstützung für den Start einer globalen Allianz zur Zusammenarbeit zwischen südlichen Ländern und trilateraler Kooperation aus und betonte deren Bedeutung für die Förderung der Integration und Verringerung doppelter Anstrengungen.

it.title: L'Arabia Saudita Accoglie il Lancio dell'«Alleanza di Cooperazione tra Paesi del Sud»
it.summary: L'Arabia Saudita ha espresso sostegno al lancio di un'alleanza globale per la cooperazione tra i paesi del sud e la cooperazione trilaterale, sottolineandone l'importanza nel promuovere l'integrazione e ridurre gli sforzi duplicati.

ru.title: Саудовская Аравия Приветствует Запуск «Альянса Сотрудничества между Странами Юга»
ru.summary: Саудовская Аравия выразила поддержку запуску глобального альянса сотрудничества между странами Юга и трехстороннего сотрудничества, подчеркнув его важность для укрепления интеграции и сокращения дублирования усилий.

ar.title: السعودية ترحب بإطلاق «تحالف التعاون بين بلدان الجنوب»
ar.summary: رحبت السعودية بإطلاق التحالف العالمي للتعاون بين بلدان الجنوب والتعاون الثلاثي، معتبرة أهميته في تعزيز التكامل والحد من ازدواجية الجهود مع احترام أولويات الدول.

hi.title: सऊदी अरब दक्षिण देशों के बीच सहयोग गठबंधन के शुभारंभ का स्वागत करता है
hi.summary: सऊदी अरब ने दक्षिणी देशों के बीच सहयोग के लिए एक वैश्विक गठबंधन और त्रिपक्षीय सहयोग के शुभारंभ का स्वागत किया, जो एकीकरण को बढ़ावा देने और प्रत्येक राष्ट्र की प्राथमिकताओं का सम्मान करते हुए दोहरे प्रयासों को कम करने में महत्वपूर्ण है।

zh.title: 沙特阿拉伯欢迎南方国家合作联盟的启动
zh.summary: 沙特阿拉伯表示欢迎启动南方国家全球合作联盟和三边合作，强调其在促进一体化和减少重复努力同时尊重各国优先事项中的重要性。

ja.title: サウジアラビア、「南方国家協力同盟」の発足を歓迎
ja.summary: サウジアラビアは、南方国家間の世界的協力同盟および三国間協力の発足を支持する立場を表明し、統合の促進と各国の優先事項を尊重しながら重複した努力を削減する上での重要性を強調した。

ko.title: 사우디아라비아, '남방국가 협력 연합' 출범 환영
ko.summary: 사우디아라비아는 남방국가 간 글로벌 협력 연합 및 삼국 협력의 출범을 지지한다는 입장을 표명했으며, 각국의 우선순위를 존중하면서 통합을 촉진하고 중복된 노력을 줄이는 데 있어 이의 중요성을 강조했다.

es.summary: El Ministerio de Turismo saudita ha actualizado las regulaciones para servicios de viajes, guías turísticas, instalaciones hoteleras y unidades de hospitalidad privada para modernizar el sector.

fr.summary: Le ministère saoudien du Tourisme a mis à jour les réglementations concernant les services de voyage, les guides touristiques, les installations hôtelières et les unités d'hospitalité privée.

pt.summary: O Ministério do Turismo saudita atualizou regulamentações para serviços de viagem, guias turísticos, instalações de hospedagem e unidades de hospitalidade privada.

de.summary: Das saudi-arabische Tourismusministerium hat Vorschriften für Reisedienste, Fremdenführer, Beherbergungseinrichtungen und private Beherbergungseinheiten aktualisiert.

it.title: Il ministero del Turismo dell'Arabia Saudita aggiorna quattro regolamenti
it.summary: Il ministero saudita del Turismo ha aggiornato i regolamenti per i servizi di viaggio, le guide turistiche, le strutture ricettive e le unità ricettive private.

ru.title: Министерство туризма Саудовской Аравии обновило четыре нормативных акта
ru.summary: Министерство туризма Саудовской Аравии обновило нормативные акты, касающиеся туристических услуг, экскурсионных гидов, гостиничных учреждений и частных единиц размещения.

zh.title: 沙特旅游部更新四项规定
zh.summary: 沙特阿拉伯旅游部更新了旅游服务、导游、酒店设施和私人酒店单位的规定。

ja.summary: サウジアラビア観光省は、旅行サービス、ツアーガイド、ホスピタリティ施設、および民間ホスピタリティユニットの規制を更新しました。

ko.title: 사우디 관광부가 4개 규정 업데이트

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns pipeline targeting and grants Iraq opportunity to prevent attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia condemned drone attacks on its East-West pipeline originating from Iraq that caused casualties and damage. The kingdom said it would give Iraq a chance to prevent future attacks from its territory rather than responding militarily at this stage.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West oil pipeline after multiple attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia shuts East-West oil pipeline after multiple attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia closed its East-West Pipeline as a precautionary measure following multiple attacks in the Riyadh and Madinah regions on Thursday that caused injuries. Emergency teams secured the pipeline and assessed its safety according to approved procedures.

stories.title: السعودية تدين استهداف خط «شرق - غرب»... والعراق يقيل مسؤولاً أمنياً

en.summary: Saudi Arabia strongly condemned drone attacks on its East-West Pipeline originating from Iraq, which resulted in casualties and damage. Iraq dismissed a security official in response to the incident.

en.title: Saudi Arabia condemns drone attack from Iraq after East-West Pipeline shut as precaution
en.summary: Saudi Arabia temporarily closed its East-West Pipeline after it was hit by multiple drone attacks in the Riyadh and Madinah regions, causing injuries. Technical teams were deployed to secure and assess the pipeline.

en.title: Antonelli leads practice on new Madring track as F1's Spanish GP returns to Madrid
en.summary: Formula 1's Spanish Grand Prix returned to Madrid at the new Madring circuit, where driver Kimi Antonelli set the pace during practice. The challenging track layout presented difficulties for drivers but saw few major incidents.

en.title: Saudi Arabia updates four tourism regulations covering travel, guides and hospitality
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Ministry of Tourism updated four regulations governing travel services, tourist guides, and hospitality facilities to improve service quality and visitor experience. The changes aim to align with tourism growth and evolving business models.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia urges firm UN Security Council action over Houthi attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia urges firm UN Security Council action over Houthi attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia called on the UN Security Council to take strong action against Houthi attacks on the Kingdom. The country warned that these attacks threaten regional security and international navigation in the Red Sea and Bab Al-Mandab.

stories.title: Antonelli Looks to Keep Momentum as F1 Drivers Face Unknown Challenges of Madrid Track at Spanish GP

en.title: Antonelli Looks to Keep Momentum as F1 Drivers Face Unknown Challenges of Madrid Track at Spanish GP
en.summary: Formula 1 driver Antonelli aims to maintain momentum at the Spanish Grand Prix on the Madrid track, which presents new challenges for competitors.

stories.title: ‎US inflation holds steady at 3.4% in August

en.title: US inflation holds steady at 3.4% in August
en.summary: US annual consumer price inflation remained unchanged at 3.4% in August, while monthly inflation increased due to higher energy prices, particularly gasoline which surged 3.9%.

stories.title: ‎Batterjee Holding plans Tadawul listing in 2028: Chairman

en.title: Batterjee Holding plans Tadawul listing in 2028: Chairman
en.summary: Batterjee Holding is restructuring its operations and plans to list on the Saudi Exchange in 2028 as part of efforts to expand its brand and distribution activities.

stories.title: ‎Global banks raise oil price forecasts amid Hormuz disruptions

en.title: Global banks raise oil price forecasts amid Hormuz disruptions
en.summary: Major global banks have increased their Brent crude price forecasts this week due to shipping disruptions in the Middle East that have tightened oil markets. Commerzbank raised its year-end forecast to $85 per barrel, while HSBC revised its 2026 and 2027 forecasts to $90 and $85 per barrel respectively.

stories.title: ‎Saudi Arabia weighs EA-Savvy merger to create global gaming giant

en.title: Saudi Arabia weighs EA-Savvy merger to create global gaming giant
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund is considering merging Electronic Arts with Savvy Games Group to create one of the world's largest gaming companies. The fund aims to better coordinate its gaming portfolio, though no final decisions have been made.

stories.title: ‎IEA sees further decline in global oil supply

en.title: IEA sees further decline in global oil supply
en.summary: The International Energy Agency forecasts global oil demand will fall by 2.5 million barrels per day this year and supply will decline by 5.7 million bpd to 100.7 million bpd in 2026. The ongoing Middle East conflict is delaying production recovery in the region.
